Street address of the British Library, London — Answered.
The British Library in London is at 96 Euston Road, London NW1 2DB. The library's own website gives this as its London address and shows it in a 2026 copyright line (the cited sources do not show: 2026). [1] [2] [3]

Sources
[1] Visit the British Library — https://www.bl.uk/visit (search result age: 163 days ago)

[3] British Library — https://www.visitlondon.com/things-to-do/place/283871-the-british-library
